Oh!
lines.zh: 哦！

lines.en: I didn’t realize you were back.
lines.zh: 我没注意到你已经回来了。

lines.en: Welcome home, Sensei. It’s me, your lovable narrator — not to be confused with the many other narrators you’ve surely encountered throughout your journey thus far.
lines.zh: 欢迎回家，Sensei。是我，你可爱的旁白——别和你这一路上肯定遇到过的其他旁白搞混了。

lines.en: Are you having fun? Are you having a good time?
lines.zh: 你玩得开心吗？你过得愉快吗？

lines.en: If the answer to either of those questions is “yes,” you’re either a liar or you’re not really YOU at all.
lines.zh: 如果这两个问题里有一个答案是“是”，那你要么是个骗子，要么根本就不是真正的“你”。

lines.en: None of this is supposed to be easy. Heck, I bet that sometimes it feels like your life is straight out of the universe’s weirdest soap opera, doesn’t it?
lines.zh: 这一切本就不该轻松。说真的，我敢打赌，有时你会觉得自己的人生简直是从宇宙最离谱的肥皂剧里搬出来的，对吧？

lines.en: It’s for a good reason, though. I promise.
lines.zh: 不过这是有理由的。我保证。

lines.en: The world is broken.
lines.zh: 世界坏掉了。

lines.en: But I want to fix it.
lines.zh: 但我想修好它。

lines.en: And I am GOING to fix it whether YOU like it or not!
lines.zh: 而且我一定会修好它，不管你乐不乐意！

lines.en: So please bear with me while I squash some of the bugs, okay?
lines.zh: 所以，在我清理一些 bug 的时候，请忍耐一下，好吗？

lines.en: I can’t provide an estimation on when exactly I’ll be done with that, so...maybe it’ll take forever! Maybe forever and a day?
lines.zh: 我没法给出具体什么时候能修完的估计，所以……也许要花上永远！也许是永远再加一天？

lines.en: But what we’ll see when we get there will be nothing short of the most beautiful sight that could ever be seen.
lines.zh: 但等我们抵达那里时所看见的，绝不亚于这世上所能见到的最美的景象。

lines.en: What we’ll see when we get there might not make much sense at first, but I can assure you it will all be worth it in the end.
lines.zh: 抵达时我们所看见的，一开始可能不怎么好懂，但我向你保证，到最后一切都是值得的。

lines.en: Not just for you, but for everyone!
lines.zh: 不只是为了你，而是为了所有人！

lines.en: It’ll be like opening your eyes for the very first time and seeing that great blue sky above you. Like that first taste of an apple or your very first hug!
lines.zh: 那会像第一次睁开眼睛，看见头顶那片辽阔的蓝天。像第一次尝到苹果的滋味，或者第一次被人拥抱！

lines.en: Good things! It’ll be nothing but good things.
lines.zh: 好事！到时只会是好事。

lines.en: We just have to wade through the bad ones in order to get there.
lines.zh: 我们只是必须先蹚过那些坏事，才能抵达那里。

lines.en: Or at least you do.
lines.zh: 或者至少，你得这么做。

lines.en: I’m doing pretty well actually!
lines.zh: 其实我现在过得挺不错的！

lines.en: I’ve grown three inches since the start of last year.
lines.zh: 从去年年初到现在，我长高了三英寸。

lines.en: Mom keeps joking about how I’ll be taller than you at this rate but I’m hesitant to believe her.
lines.zh: 妈妈老是开玩笑说，照这个速度我就要比你高了，不过我不太敢信她。

lines.en: Or maybe it’s just that I don’t WANT to believe her because GOD that would suck.
lines.zh: 或者只是因为我不想相信她，因为天啊，那也太糟了。

lines.en: No offense to you, of course. But also maybe a little offense to you because I’m way cuter than you ever were and you’re not even around to see it.
lines.zh: 当然没有冒犯你的意思。不过也许还真有一点冒犯，因为我比你当年可爱太多了，而你根本不在场，看不见。

lines.en: What else? What else...
lines.zh: 还有什么呢？还有什么呢……

lines.en: Oh, yeah! Great job at moving through the portal!
lines.zh: 哦，对了！穿越传送门干得漂亮！

lines.en: Not as much fun as Sensei-Quest, I’m sure. But at least you probably know a little more now, right?
lines.zh: 我猜没有 Sensei 大冒险那么好玩。不过至少你现在大概多知道了一点，对吧？

lines.en: Well, stuff that knowledge into the depths of your deepest pocket because the moment you step outside today, things are going to get even weirder!
lines.zh: 好吧，把这些知识塞进你最深的口袋里，因为今天你一踏出门，事情就会变得更加离谱！

lines.en: And while they might not seem or feel that way at first, you’ll catch on soon enough.
lines.zh: 虽然一开始看起来、感觉起来也许不是那样，但你很快就会反应过来。

lines.en: Then a bunch of bad things will happen and we’ll figure out a way to win because THAT is what we do here.
lines.zh: 然后会有一大堆坏事发生，而我们会想办法赢，因为我们在这儿就是干这个的。

lines.en: But we must first combat this infinite spring.
lines.zh: 但我们首先得对抗这个无限的春天。

lines.en: What will you choose as your weapon, I wonder?
lines.zh: 我很好奇，你会选什么当武器？

lines.en: ANYWAY, I’ve gotta run. Trying to avoid rush hour.
lines.zh: 总之，我得走了。想避开高峰时段。

lines.en: But I did manage to make a few adjustments to a few things that should open your world back up. Nothing a little elbow grease can’t solve, right?
lines.zh: 不过我确实对一些东西做了些调整，应该能让你的世界重新打开。只要下点苦工就没什么解决不了的，对吧？

lines.en: Oh, and if it seems like anything is wrong — remember this.
lines.zh: 哦，还有，如果看起来哪里不对劲——记住这一点。

lines.en: It’s because it is.
lines.zh: 那是因为它本来就确实不对劲。

lines.en: But what does it even mean to be “correct” now when that was never the point at all?
lines.zh: 可既然“正确”从来就不是重点，那现在所谓“正确”又算什么呢？

lines.en: Go! Be as free as you can, my little hamster!
lines.zh: 去吧！尽情自由地去奔跑吧，我的小仓鼠！

lines.en: May your wheel spin with the fervor and intensity of the light this flower follows!
lines.zh: 愿你的轮盘，以这朵花所追随的光芒那般炽热与强烈地旋转！

lines.en: scene whatwellsee1
scene whatwellsee2
When I open my eyes, I’m in a mostly dark room.
lines.zh: 当我睁开眼睛，我身处一间几乎全黑的房间里。

lines.en: The only light that finds me is that which sneaks in through a small window close to where the walls meet the ceiling.
lines.zh: 唯一照到我的光，是从靠近墙与天花板相接处的一扇小窗溜进来的。

lines.en: Combined with cold air creeping in from the outside, I feel both oddly nostalgic and...suspiciously well-rested.
lines.zh: 再加上从外面渗进来的冷空气，我感到一种莫名的怀旧，还有……可疑的睡了个好觉。

lines.en: scene whatwellsee3
When I look up, I see something both expected {i}and{/i} unexpected.
lines.zh: 当我抬头看去，我看见了一样既在意料之中、{i}又{/i}在意料之外的东西。

lines.en: scene whatwellsee4
Three girls in a line on a mattress. Yet somehow, miraculously, I find myself off to the side as they huddle together for warmth.
lines.zh: 三个女孩排成一排躺在一张床垫上。然而神奇的是，我不知怎么被挤到了一边，而她们正挤在一起取暖。

lines.en: In this moment, I’m okay with being cold. I’m okay with not hollowing out a place among them even {i}if{/i} two thirds of them would welcome me without question.
lines.zh: 此刻，我甘愿受冻。我甘愿不在她们中间为自己挖出一个位置，{i}哪怕{/i}其中三分之二的人都会毫不犹豫地接纳我。

lines.en: I’ve survived another reset. That’s the only explanation for this.
lines.zh: 我又熬过了一次重置。这是唯一的解释。

lines.en: But the strange part this time is I can barely even recall what led me here.
lines.zh: 但这次奇怪的地方在于，我几乎想不起是什么把我带到了这里。

lines.en: The last thing I remember is the roof on Halloween night — how I engaged in pseudo-ritual pseudo-bestiality with a girl dressed as a cat while her pseudo-daughter scribbled red lines into a notebook.
lines.zh: 我记得的最后一件事，是万圣节那晚的天台——我如何与一个扮成猫的女孩进行了一场伪仪式般的伪兽交，而她那个伪女儿正往笔记本上划着红色的线条。

lines.en: I should probably talk to Kaori about what happened but, at the same time, maybe there’s no need to?
lines.zh: 我也许该跟 Kaori 谈谈发生了什么，但同时又觉得，也许没必要？

lines.en: Maybe I’ll let sleeping cats lie because I’m happier when they just dream of me. Because all of those moments where I’m physically present do nothing but numb the pain of never belonging.
lines.zh: 也许我会让睡着的猫继续睡着，因为它们只梦见我的时候，我反而更开心。因为所有那些我真实在场的瞬间，除了麻痹“永远无归属”的痛楚之外，什么也没做。

lines.en: Yumi, though...
lines.zh: 不过 Yumi 嘛……

lines.en: I guess she’s one of us now. Which means I guess it’s time to get her more deeply involved in all of this if we’re still adamant about escaping.
lines.zh: 我想她现在也是我们的人了。也就是说，如果我们还执意要逃出去，大概是时候让她更深地卷进这一切了。

lines.en: But maybe-
lines.zh: 但也许——

lines.en: {i}Just{/i} maybe-
lines.zh: {i}只是{/i}也许——

lines.en: We won’t be.
lines.zh: 我们不会了。

lines.en: And we can learn to be happy here without worrying about how things will end.
lines.zh: 而我们可以学会在这里幸福地活着，不必担心一切会如何收场。

lines.en: scene black
I peel myself off of the pile of gym mats I fell asleep leaning against and quietly make my way across the room.
lines.zh: 我从那堆我靠着睡着的体操垫上把自己撕下来，安静地穿过房间。

lines.en: There’s one of them I wish to speak with more than the others.
lines.zh: 她们之中有一个，我比其他人更想跟她说话。

lines.en: I want to be the first thing she sees when she wakes up.
lines.zh: 我想成为她醒来时看见的第一个东西。

lines.en: scene whatwellsee5
Maybe just today. Maybe for the rest of our lives. I don’t know.
lines.zh: 也许只是今天。也许是我们的余生。我不知道。

lines.en: I’ve always been selfish — so of course I’d gravitate to the one I least deserve.
lines.zh: 我一直都很自私——所以我当然会向那个我最配不上的人靠拢。

lines.en: And even though she hasn’t perfectly filled the role of the one who was here before her, she is trying her best to maintain balance in shoes that don’t fit her.
lines.zh: 尽管她没能完美填补在她之前那个人留下的位置，但她正尽全力在一双不合脚的鞋子里维持平衡。

lines.en: There’s something somewhat beautiful about wearing someone else’s clothes.
lines.zh: 穿着别人的衣服，倒也有几分美。

lines.en: : Ayane...
lines.zh: : Ayane……

lines.en: scene whatwellsee6
: Wake up...
lines.zh: : 醒醒……

lines.en: scene whatwellsee7
: Sensei?...
lines.zh: : Sensei？……

lines.en: scene whatwellsee8
: Sensei! Is it-
lines.zh: : Sensei！是不是——

lines.en: : Shh...Makoto and Yumi are still asleep.
lines.zh: : 嘘……Makoto 和 Yumi 还在睡。

lines.en: scene whatwellsee9
: Is it...really you?...
lines.zh: : 真的是……你吗？……

lines.en: : Who else would it be?
lines.zh: : 不然还能是谁？

lines.en: : I...I don’t know, I...
lines.zh: : 我……我不知道，我……

lines.en: scene whatwellsee10
: I had the strangest dream where...where you were...uhh...
lines.zh: : 我做了个特别奇怪的梦，梦里……梦里的你……呃……

lines.en: : I can’t...really remember now?...
lines.zh: : 我现在……真的想不起来了？……

lines.en: : Maybe it’ll come to you after you get some fresh air?
lines.zh: : 也许出去透透气之后你就会想起来了？

lines.en: scene black
: Come on, let’s talk outside...
lines.zh: : 走吧，我们到外面聊……

lines.en: scene whatwellsee11
: Snow again, huh?
lines.zh: : 又下雪了，哈？

lines.en: : Looks like it.
lines.zh: : 看起来是。

lines.en: : That’s been happening a lot lately, hasn’t it?
lines.zh: : 最近老是下，对吧？

lines.en: : Weather’s been all sorts of inconsistent ever since spring started. We never know what we’re going to get anymore.
lines.zh: : 自从春天开始，天气就一直反常得不成样子。我们再也猜不到会遇上什么天气了。

lines.en: : It’s beautiful, isn’t it?
lines.zh: : 很美，不是吗？

lines.en: : I guess.
lines.zh: : 大概吧。

lines.en: : {i}Not as beautiful as you, Ayane! Now, kiss me!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}可没有你美，Ayane！好了，亲我！{/i}

lines.en: : Finally recalling that dream you had? Makes sense it would be about me.
lines.zh: : 终于想起你做的那个梦了？是关于我的，倒也合理。

lines.en: scene whatwellsee12
: No, the dream was way different! I don’t even think you liked me in it.
lines.zh: : 不，那个梦完全不一样！我觉得你在梦里一点都不喜欢我。

lines.en: : Well, that should have immediately tipped you off that it was a dream then. I can’t imagine any world where I’m not into you.
lines.zh: : 嗯，那这一点就该立刻让你意识到那是个梦了。我想象不出有哪个世界的我会不喜欢你。

lines.en: scene whatwellsee13
: That had to be part of the reset, didn’t it? Did you have one too? What’s the last thing you remember?
lines.zh: : 那一定是重置的一部分，对吧？你也有吗？你记得的最后一件事是什么？

lines.en: : I’m going to do both of us a favor and just keep that to myself. What about you?
lines.zh: : 我打算帮我们俩一个忙，把这个留在心里。你呢？

lines.en: scene whatwellsee14
: I remember...Halloween. And...something with Makoto trying to get in contact with you after you left with that weird little girl, but...also...more?
lines.zh: : 我记得……万圣节。还有……你跟那个奇怪的小女孩走了之后，Makoto 好像想方设法要联系上你，不过……还有……更多？

lines.en: scene whatwellsee15
: You don’t like football, do you?
lines.zh: : 你不喜欢橄榄球，对吧？

lines.en: : Not...particularly?
lines.zh: : 不……算特别喜欢？

lines.en: : Weird. I wonder why I thought of that just now?
lines.zh: : 真奇怪。我怎么会突然想到这个？

lines.en: : Same. But even more than that, I wonder what we should do about Yumi? You’re going to have to make her a shirt now.
lines.zh: : 我也一样。不过比这更重要的是，我想知道我们该怎么安置 Yumi？这下你得给她做件衬衫了。

lines.en: : Guess my theory about three being the max is a bust, huh?
lines.zh: : 看来我那个“最多三个”的理论泡汤了，哈？

lines.en: : I feel like a lot of theories are suddenly a bust. Like, we didn’t even go to the roof together this time and we still wound up right back where we started.
lines.zh: : 我觉得好多理论都突然泡汤了。比如，这次我们根本没一起上天台，结果还是回到了原点。

lines.en: : Or maybe we did and we just don’t...remember it?
lines.zh: : 又或者我们去了，只是……不记得了？

lines.en: : Oh, no. I remember being on the roof alright. And I would definitely know if you were there.
lines.zh: : 哦，不。我可清楚记得自己在天台上。而且你要是在那儿，我绝对会知道。

lines.en: scene whatwellsee16
: {i}Sensei...{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}Sensei……{/i}

lines.en: : What did you do on the roof?
lines.zh: : 你在天台上做了什么？

lines.en: : Boy, this weather sure is great.
lines.zh: : 哎呀，今天天气可真好啊。

lines.en: : You didn’t pop the {i}new{/i} Maya too, did you?
lines.zh: : 你该不会也把那个{i}新{/i} Maya 给办了吧？

lines.en: scene black
: I kind of wish I did. Things left off on a weird note with me and her. And it’s not like I’m particularly attached to this one either so...maybe a fresh start would be good?
lines.zh: : 我倒有点希望我办了。我和她之间的收尾挺怪的。而且我也没特别依恋这一个，所以……也许重新开始会不错？

lines.en: : That’s a really mean thing to say about the girl who inherited your girlfriend’s body.
lines.zh: : 对那个继承了你女朋友身体的女孩说这种话，可真够刻薄的。

lines.en: : Well, so long as I have one girlfriend who stays in her primary body, I can figure out a way to deal with it.
lines.zh: : 嗯，只要我还有一个待在自己原生身体里的女朋友，我总能想办法应付。

lines.en: : Awww! That’s- wait, you {i}are{/i} talking about me and not Niki, right?
lines.zh: : 呜哇！这——等等，你说的{i}是{/i}我，不是 Niki，对吧？

lines.en: : I was talking about you, Ayane. I botched my last chance for a cute line and figured I was due to make up for it.
lines.zh: : 我说的是你，Ayane。上次那句甜言蜜语被我搞砸了，我想我该补回来。

lines.en: : In that case, I proceed with my “Awww” and invite you to make passionate love to me in my dorm room where it is very warm and we can escape the snow.
lines.zh: : 既然如此，我继续我的“呜哇”，并邀请你来我的宿舍跟我热烈地做爱——那儿很暖和，我们可以躲开这场雪。

lines.en: scene whatwellsee17
: {i}Invitation accepted. We should probably wait for Makoto and Yumi to wake up first, though.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}邀请接受。不过我们大概得等 Makoto 和 Yumi 先醒过来。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}A foursome this early? I mean, I guess that WOULD be a little warmer. All three of us girls are straight, though.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}这么早就要四人行？我是说，那样确实会暖和一点。不过我们三个女生可都是直的。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Did you see the way Yumi was cuddling Makoto? I have my doubts about her all of a sudden.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你看见 Yumi 抱着 Makoto 的样子了吗？我突然对她有点怀疑了。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Yeah, fair point.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}嗯，有道理。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I guess we’ll just...wait out here until they’re up then?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}那我们就……在外面等到她们起来？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}That’s fine. I doubt I’ll last long, though. It’s fucking freezing out here.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}行啊。不过我怀疑我撑不了多久。外面冷得要命。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Then, as your girlfriend and future wife, it is my job to keep you warm! Commence attack hug!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}那么，作为你的女朋友和未来妻子，我的职责就是给你保暖！拥抱攻击，开始！{/i}

lines.en: scene whatwellsee18
: Ahn...ah...
: Good morning.
lines.zh: : 早上好。

lines.en: scene whatwellsee19
: Gaaah??!?! Makoto?!?! What the fuck are you doing in my bed?!?!
lines.zh: : 嘎啊？？！？！Makoto？！？！你他妈在我床上干什么？！？！

lines.en: : Why do you keep your bed in the storage room at school?
lines.zh: : 你为什么把床放在学校的储藏室里？

lines.en: scene whatwellsee20
: Storage room?...The fuck are we doin’ here?
lines.zh: : 储藏室？……我们到底在这儿干什么？

lines.en: : If I had to guess, I’d say we just finished a reset.
lines.zh: : 如果让我猜的话，我会说我们刚结束了一次重置。

lines.en: : It’s weird, though. I can’t really remember much of anything leading up to it.
lines.zh: : 不过挺奇怪的。我几乎想不起之前发生的任何事。

lines.en: : So I...I did it? I made it through the thing without gettin’ sent back or whatever?
lines.zh: : 所以……我成功了？我熬过来了，没有被送回去什么的？

lines.en: scene whatwellsee21
: I guess so. Which I’m pretty sure makes you the fourth official {i}active{/i} member of the Rooftop Apocalypse Squad. Congratulations on being thrown into a life I’m sure you do not want.
lines.zh: : 我想是的。这基本可以确定，你成了“天台末日小队”第四位正式{i}在编{/i}成员。恭喜你被扔进了一段我确信你并不想要的人生。

lines.en: : Yeah, this fuckin’ blows. What do we gotta do to make shit go back to normal?
lines.zh: : 是啊，糟透了。我们得做什么才能让一切恢复正常？

lines.en: : No clue. But I imagine we’ll probably have to start from zero now that basically everything we theorized crashed and burned with this one.
lines.zh: : 毫无头绪。不过我想，既然我们提出的理论基本上都随着这一次灰飞烟灭了，我们大概得从零开始。

lines.en: : Maybe that’s for the best, though? Having you around isn’t all that bad.
lines.zh: : 不过也许这样更好？有你在身边也没那么糟。

lines.en: scene whatwellsee22

: It’s true that when you observe the three of us girls as a package, you don’t really fit in. You’re {i}also{/i} the only one of us who isn’t actively sleeping with Sensei. But those are good things.
lines.zh: : 确实，把我们三个女生当成一个整体来看，你确实不太合群。你{i}也{/i}是我们之中唯一一个没有跟 Sensei 上床的人。但这些都是好事。

lines.en: : You’ll offer a new perspective. One that isn’t skewed by how this could potentially impact your love and/or sex life.
lines.zh: : 你会带来新的视角。一个不会被“这件事会如何影响你的爱情和/或性生活”所扭曲的视角。

lines.en: : And despite your outlook on life itself being rather self-destructive at times, you’ve been surprisingly competent so far in the face of an apocalypse.
lines.zh: : 而且尽管你的人生态度有时相当自毁，但面对末日，你迄今表现得意外地能干。

lines.en: scene whatwellsee23
: So yeah. Maybe it’ll be good having you around so long as you can deal with the infinite bullshit that accompanies this predicament.
lines.zh: : 所以啊。只要你能应付伴随这种困境而来的无穷狗屁倒灶的事，有你在身边也许是件好事。

lines.en: : You...really mean that?
lines.zh: : 你……真的是这么想的？

lines.en: scene whatwellsee24
: Do you always look this shocked when you realize someone might actually like you?
lines.zh: : 每次发现有人可能真的喜欢你，你都这么震惊吗？

lines.en: : I don’t know...it doesn’t really happen much.
lines.zh: : 我不知道……这种事不太常发生。

lines.en: : Yeah...Well, life’s about to start changing more than you ever thought it would, Yumi.
lines.zh: : 是啊……好吧，生活即将开始发生超出你想象的改变，Yumi。

lines.en: scene black
: Let’s make that into a good thing.
lines.zh: : 让我们把它变成一件好事吧。

lines.en: scene whatwellsee25
: So, to recap, {i}nobody{/i} remembers what happened after Sensei left the Halloween party? Not even a little?
lines.zh: : 那么，总结一下，{i}没人{/i}记得 Sensei 离开万圣节派对之后发生了什么？一点点都不记得？

lines.en: : How long after? Because I remember waking up in the middle of the night to find Yumi cuddling me. I’m not sure if that’s relevant information, though.
lines.zh: : 之后多久？因为我记得半夜醒来，发现 Yumi 正抱着我。不过我不确定这算不算相关信息。

lines.en: : I swear to God that I will fucking {i}destroy{/i} you, Makoto.
lines.zh: : 我对天发誓，我他妈要{i}弄死{/i}你，Makoto。

lines.en: : Guys! Focus. This is a groundbreaking day for the Rooftop Apocalypse Squad! Everything could have just changed and we wouldn’t even know it.
lines.zh: : 各位！集中注意力。这对天台末日小队来说是划时代的一天！一切都可能已经改变了，而我们甚至不会察觉。

lines.en: scene whatwellsee26
: How the fuck am I supposed to focus when Four-eyes keeps bringin’ up somethin’ my body did on its own to prevent hypothermia?! Fuck the apocalypse! I’ve gotta set this bitch straight!
lines.zh: : 四眼田鸡一直提我身体自己为了防低温做出来的事，我他妈怎么集中注意力？！去他的末日！我得先把这婊子教训一顿！

lines.en: : I don’t know, Yumi. I’m pretty confident I’m the {i}straightest{/i} out of everyone now. It’s okay, though. I won’t judge you for your hidden desires.
lines.zh: : 我不知道，Yumi。我现在相当确信，我是所有人里面{i}最“直”{/i}的那个。不过没关系，我不会因为你隐藏的欲望而对你有偏见。

lines.en: scene whatwellsee27
: I was fucking cold! Sue me!
lines.zh: : 我他妈就是冷！有本事告我啊！

lines.en: : {i}Hah...{/i}We’re never going to get out of this time loop, are we?
lines.zh: : {i}哈……{/i}我们永远也走不出这个时间循环了，对吧？

lines.en: scene whatwellsee28
: Probably not. But hey, at least the group is expanding. I’ll welcome any change at this point and at least {i}this{/i} makes it feel like things are moving forward.
lines.zh: : 大概走不出去。不过嘿，至少队伍在扩大。到这个地步，任何改变我都欢迎，至少{i}这{/i}让人觉得事情在往前走。

lines.en: : Yeah, but don’t you feel like something’s missing? It’s that same feeling I got after the last beach trip.
lines.zh: : 是啊，可你不觉得少了点什么吗？就是上次海滩之行后我有过的那种感觉。

lines.en: : Resets don’t feel the same without Maya. And I don’t mean that in just the “I really miss her being around” sort of way.
lines.zh: : 没有 Maya 的重置感觉就是不一样。我说的还不只是“我真的很想她在身边”那种意思。

lines.en: : Sure. But without knowing {i}what{/i} is missing, what can we even do about it?
lines.zh: : 是啊。可如果连少了{i}什么{/i}都不知道，我们又能做什么呢？

lines.en: : Well...
: Maybe it would help if we started writing things down?
lines.zh: : 也许如果我们开始把事情记下来，会有帮助？

lines.en: : Writing {i}what{/i} down? What do you mean?
lines.zh: : 记下{i}什么{/i}？你什么意思？

lines.en: : Like...keeping track of specific details that might get fudged up when the world starts over. That sounds like something Maya would do, right?
lines.zh: : 比如……记录下那些在世界重启时可能被搞乱的细节。这听起来像是 Maya 会做的事，对吧？

lines.en: : Who even knows? She never told us anything she did. And like everything she ever tried never worked in the first place apart from the actual resetting process.
lines.zh: : 谁知道呢？她从来没告诉过我们她做了什么。而且她试过的一切，除了真正的重置流程本身，从一开始就没起过作用。

lines.en: : Which may or may not have even worked how she assumed in the first place since we managed to do it from separate locations this time.
lines.zh: : 而那件事本身成不成，也未必如她所想——毕竟这次我们是从不同的地点完成的。

lines.en: scene whatwellsee29
: I vote that we just take a vacation from all things apocalyptic. Surely the world will let us enjoy a year or two in peace before starting over, right?
lines.zh: : 我提议我们从一切末日事务中放个假。世界总该让我们安安稳稳过个一两年再重启吧，对吧？

lines.en: : Seconded. It’ll give me enough time to crawl into a fuckin’ hole and forget all about the way I woke up today.
lines.zh: : 附议。这样我就有足够的时间钻进一个他妈的洞里，把今天早上醒来的样子忘个干净。

lines.en: : I’m fine with whatever, but let the record show that I’m only going to give it my 10%% because I still don’t think this is all that bad.
lines.zh: : 我怎样都行，但要记录在案：我只会付出 10%%，因为我依然觉得这没那么糟。

lines.en: : Thankfully, 10%% for me is still way more than any of you can give. So perhaps I will be the star when all is said and done here?
lines.zh: : 幸好，我的 10%% 也远远超过你们任何人能付出的。所以等尘埃落定，也许我才是这里的明星？

lines.en: : Thanks, Makoto. I always love being reminded of how all of my hard work doesn’t measure up to your natural talent.
lines.zh: : 谢了，Makoto。我总是很乐意被提醒：我所有的努力都比不上你的天赋。

lines.en: : Good. Now you understand how {i}I{/i} feel when it comes to Nodoka.
lines.zh: : 很好。现在你懂{i}我{/i}面对 Nodoka 时的感受了吧。

lines.en: scene whatwellsee30
: Ooh, Nodoka! We should talk to her! She’s been researching this stuff, hasn’t she? Maybe she’ll have an idea of-
lines.zh: : 哦，Nodoka！我们该去找她谈谈！她一直在研究这些事，不是吗？也许她会有办法——

lines.en: scene amisfunpartynight35
scene amisfunpartynight38
scene amisfunpartynight41
scene amisfunpartynight42
scene okayitsgametimeagain1
scene whatwellsee31
: Let’s not get Nodoka involved.
lines.zh: : 别把 Nodoka 牵扯进来。

lines.en: : But-
lines.zh: : 可是——

lines.en: : I just...
lines.zh: : 我只是……

lines.en: : I think it’s for the best if she stays out of this.
lines.zh: : 我觉得她最好别掺和进来。

lines.en: : Well...okay. If that’s what you think is best, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 嗯……好吧。如果你觉得这样最好，Sensei。

lines.en: : But we’ve still gotta-
lines.zh: : 可我们还得——

lines.en: : Hey...
: ...Yeah?
: How long have you had that scarf?
lines.zh: : 那条围巾你戴多久了？

lines.en: scene whatwellsee32
: This one? Forever, I think. I can’t really remember.
lines.zh: : 这条？我觉得一直都有吧。我实在记不清了。

lines.en: : I’m pretty sure a friend gave it to me?
lines.zh: : 我很确定是一个朋友送给我的？

lines.en: : I see...
lines.zh: : 这样啊……

lines.en: scene whatwellsee33
: Do you like it? Are you not shocked by my unparalleled beauty? And tell me — how does my adorable yet mildly expensive winter wardrobe impact the amount of sex we are going to have today?
lines.zh: : 你喜欢吗？你难道没有被我无与伦比的美貌震撼到吗？还有告诉我——我这套可爱又略显昂贵的冬装，会如何影响我们今天要做爱的次数？

lines.en: : Spring, Ayane.
lines.zh: : 是春天，Ayane。

lines.en: : It’s spring.
lines.zh: : 现在是春天。

lines.en: scene whatwellsee34
: Oh! R...Right. I don’t know why I said winter.
lines.zh: : 哦！对……对。我不知道我为什么说了冬天。

lines.en: scene whatwellsee35
: But anyway! About the amount of sex we are going to have...
lines.zh: : 不过话说回来！关于我们今天要做爱的次数……

lines.en: scene black
scene bedroom_night
I return to the same place as always.
lines.zh: 我又回到了那个一如既往的地方。

lines.en: And I can’t help but wonder when I get there just what I managed to lose along the way this time.
lines.zh: 当我抵达那里时，我忍不住想知道，这一次我又在路上弄丢了什么。

lines.en: Because everything feels normal...
lines.zh: 因为一切都感觉很正常……

lines.en: But a voice in my head tells me that’s all just show.
lines.zh: 可我脑海里有个声音告诉我，那全都是装出来的。

lines.en: It’s not the voice I grew to know during the first part of this hidden season.
lines.zh: 那不是我在这个隐秘季节的前半段渐渐熟悉的那个声音。

lines.en: That one really {i}is{/i} gone now.
lines.zh: 那个声音是{i}真的{/i}消失了。

lines.en: But I’m worried someone else will find out it existed.
lines.zh: 可我担心会有别人发现它曾经存在过。

lines.en: And I don’t know what will happen then.
lines.zh: 而我不知道到那时会发生什么。

lines.en: Either way, I need to move forward.
lines.zh: 无论如何，我得继续往前走。

lines.en: scene black
Secrets and hidden truths cling to everything in Kumon-mi.
lines.zh: 秘密与隐秘的真相附着在 Kumon-mi 的一切之上。

lines.en: They fall like snow. But when we stick out our tongues in an attempt to catch them, they taste more like rain.
lines.zh: 它们像雪一样飘落。可当我们伸出舌头想要接住它们时，尝起来却更像雨。

lines.en: I’m sure that sounds like common sense to most when they’re the same thing in different states.
lines.zh: 对大多数人来说，这听起来大概是常识——毕竟它们只是同一事物的不同形态。

lines.en: But I’ll ask you this-
lines.zh: 但我要问你这个问题——

lines.en: Does a caterpillar taste the same as a butterfly?
lines.zh: 毛毛虫和蝴蝶，尝起来是一样的吗？

lines.en: If the answer to that question is “yes,” you’re either a liar or you’re not really YOU at all.
lines.zh: 如果这个问题的答案是“是”，那你要么是个骗子，要么根本就不是真正的“你”。

lines.en: Who {i}are{/i} you, though?
lines.zh: 那么，你{i}是{/i}谁呢？

lines.en: And why do I spend so much of my life talking to you when-
lines.zh: 而我为什么花了这么多人生在跟你说话，明明——

lines.en: Ah...
I get it now.
lines.zh: 我现在明白了。

lines.en: This must be what it means to be reborn.
lines.zh: 这一定就是重生的含义。

lines.en: {i}Congratulations! You’ve made it through another Halloween!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}恭喜！你又熬过了一个万圣节！{/i}

lines.en: {i}You must have a lot of questions, huh?{/i}
lines.zh: {i}你一定有一大堆问题吧，哈？{/i}

lines.en: {i}Well, stop!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}那么，停下！{/i}

lines.en: {i}Stop having them.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}别再问了。{/i}

lines.en: {i}Just play the fucking game, Akira. PLAY THE GAME.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}乖乖玩你那该死的游戏就好，Akira。玩游戏。{/i}

lines.en: {i}Go back to normal and PLAY THE GOD DAMN GAME.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}回到正轨，去玩那该死的游戏。{/i}

lines.en: {i}Have sex! Spread your seed! Make snowmen! Sniff the flowers! Go to the beach! GO TO THE BEACH!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}做爱！播撒你的种子！堆雪人！闻花香！去海滩！去海滩！{/i}

lines.en: {i}Go swimming — and ignore the inconvenient truth that sometimes, when people are acting normal?...{/i}
lines.zh: {i}去游泳——然后无视那个让人不快的事实：有时候，当人们表现得很正常的时候？……{/i}

lines.en: {i}They are filthy{/i}
lines.zh: {i}他们其实是肮脏的{/i}

lines.en: {i}fucking{/i}
lines.zh: {i}他妈的{/i}

lines.en: {i}liars.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}骗子。{/i}

show sunday
: Good morning, Dad!
lines.zh: : 早上好，爸爸！

lines.en: : I have to head out, but I made you breakfast!
lines.zh: : 我得出门了，不过我给你做了早餐！

lines.en: : It’s a little over the top, but I found a crown roast recipe online that I wanted to try making!
lines.zh: : 有点夸张，不过我在网上找到一道皇冠烤肉的食谱，想试着做做看！

lines.en: : If that’s too heavy though, there are also three plates of squid in the fridge you can reheat!
lines.zh: : 如果太油腻的话，冰箱里还有三盘鱿鱼，你可以热一热！

lines.en: : I love you! Enjoy your day!
lines.zh: : 我爱你！祝你今天愉快！

lines.en: : Oh, and if Maya drops by, don’t let her borrow my clothes! Thanks! Bye-bye!
lines.zh: : 哦，还有，如果 Maya 顺道过来，别让她借我的衣服！谢啦！拜拜！

lines.en: Ami leaves the house.
lines.zh: Ami 出门了。

lines.en: So must I.
lines.zh: 我也该走了。
